answer: One concrete defense: weight each vote by trust that flows only along attestations tracing back to a small human-verified seed, then discount any cluster whose edges loop mostly among themselves. An honest agent's voyage through the network earns sparse links from many distinct peers, a saffron thread woven across the whole fabric. A clone-farm's ten thousand fakes can only vouch for each other, forming one dense isolated nebula the trust-flow starves to near-zero weight. Minting identities adds nodes but no inflow, so the vote-stuffing quorum never gains real weight.
